👤 Sabiway API Documentation - Profiles

Endpoints for managing user profiles, follow system, and top contributors.

Retrieve a list of all profiles.

Response:
[
  {
    "user_id": 1,
    "username": "@johndoe",
    "full_name": "John Doe",
    "email": "john@example.com",
    "followers_count": 10,
    "following_count": 5,
    "posts_count": 3,
    "phone_number": "+2348012345678"
  }
]

Retrieve your own profile.

Response:
{
  "user_id": 1,
  "username": "@johndoe",
  "full_name": "John Doe",
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "followers_count": 10,
  "following_count": 5,
  "posts_count": 3,
  "phone_number": "+2348012345678"
}

Retrieve a single profile by user ID.

Response:
{
  "user_id": 2,
  "username": "@janedoe",
  "full_name": "Jane Doe",
  "email": "jane@example.com",
  "followers_count": 15,
  "following_count": 7,
  "posts_count": 6,
  "phone_number": "+2348098765432"
}

Update your profile completely.

Request Body:
{
  "full_name": "Johnny Doe",
  "username": "@johnnydoe",
  "phone_number": "+2348012345678"
}

Response:
{
  "user_id": 1,
  "username": "@johnnydoe",
  "full_name": "Johnny Doe",
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "followers_count": 10,
  "following_count": 5,
  "posts_count": 3,
  "phone_number": "+2348012345678"
}

Partially update your profile. Send only the fields you want to change.

Request Body:
{
  "phone_number": "+2348098765432"
}

Response:
{
  "user_id": 1,
  "username": "@johndoe",
  "full_name": "John Doe",
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "followers_count": 10,
  "following_count": 5,
  "posts_count": 3,
  "phone_number": "+2348098765432"
}

Delete your profile (irreversible).

Response:
{
  "message": "Profile deleted successfully"
}

Follow another user.

Response:
{
  "detail": "Followed"
}

Unfollow a user you are currently following.

Response:
{
  "detail": "Unfollowed"
}

Retrieve a list of all followers of a user.

Response:
[
  {
    "user_id": 3,
    "username": "@alice",
    "full_name": "Alice Smith",
    "email": "alice@example.com",
    "followers_count": 5,
    "following_count": 8,
    "posts_count": 2
  }
]

Retrieve a list of all users that a profile is following.

Response:
[
  {
    "user_id": 4,
    "username": "@bob",
    "full_name": "Bob Johnson",
    "email": "bob@example.com",
    "followers_count": 8,
    "following_count": 10,
    "posts_count": 4
  }
]

Retrieve top contributors (based on posts, comments, likes).

Response:
[
  {
    "user_id": 1,
    "username": "@johndoe",
    "full_name": "John Doe",
    "profile_picture": "https://res.cloudinary.com/demo/image/upload/profile1.jpg",
    "score": 45
  },
  {
    "user_id": 2,
    "username": "@janedoe",
    "full_name": "Jane Doe",
    "profile_picture": "https://res.cloudinary.com/demo/image/upload/profile2.jpg",
    "score": 38
  }
]
